2609.09737.title: Distilling Image Prototypes for Guided Test-Time Adaptation
2609.09737.paper_summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enhances the robustness of models against distribution shifts but faces two critical challenges: error accumulation from noisy pseudo-labels and catastrophic forgetting of source knowledge. Uncertainty-based approaches designed to mitigate error accumulation often yield overconfident or computationally expensive estimates, while strategies intended to prevent forgetting via prototype replay rely on static representations that easily become misaligned as the model adapts. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel framework, Distilling Image Prototype for Guided Test-Time Adaptation (DIPTTA). The core of the proposed approach is the introduction of a Distill Image Prototype (DIP), a compact set of synthetic images that serves as a dynamic and regenerative anchor of source knowledge. This prototype enables a dynamic feature replay mechanism that continuously generates feature prototypes aligned with the current state of the model, thus effectively preventing catastrophic forgetting. Furthermore, the DIP anchors a source-calibrated uncertainty estimation method, which provides a less biased measure of sample reliability by leveraging stable source knowledge, thereby robustly suppressing error accumulation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DIPTTA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under severe domain shifts. The source code is available at https://github.com/LiwenWang919/DIPTTA.
2609.09737.paper_summary_zh: 測試時適應（TTA）增強了模型對於分佈變化的魯棒性，但面臨兩個關鍵挑戰：來自噪聲偽標籤的錯誤累積和源知識的災難性遺忘。基於不確定性的策略旨在減輕錯誤累積，然而往往會產生過於自信或計算成本高昂的估計，而旨在通過原型重播防止遺忘的策略則依賴於靜態表示，這些表示在模型適應時容易變得不對齊。為了解決這些問題，本文提出了一個新穎的框架，稱為引導測試時適應的圖像原型蒸餾（DIPTTA）。所提出方法的核心是引入一個蒸餾圖像原型（DIP），這是一組緊湊的合成圖像，作為源知識的動態和再生錨點。這個原型使得一個動態特徵重播機制得以實現，該機制不斷生成與模型當前狀態對齊的特徵原型，從而有效防止災難性遺忘。此外，DIP 錨定了一種源校準的不確定性估計方法，通過利用穩定的源知識提供了較少偏見的樣本可靠性測量，從而穩健地抑制錯誤累積。在多個基準上的廣泛實驗表明，DIPTTA 顯著超越了最先進的方法，特別是在嚴重的領域轉變下。源代碼可在 https://github.com/LiwenWang919/DIPTTA 獲得。
